name: hushcommit
description: Generate a git commit message from the staged diff using an OpenAI-compatible server you choose.

hushcommit.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, ending in /v1. Examples: Ollama http://localhost:11434/v1, LM Studio http://localhost:1234/v1 (use the port shown in LM Studio's Developer tab).

hushcommit.model.description: Model id to use, e.g. qwen3-coder:30b. Run "Hushcommit: Select model" to pick from the server's list.

hushcommit.instructions.description: Custom system prompt. If set, it replaces the built-in prompt.

hushcommit.maxDiffChars.description: Longest staged diff (in characters) sent to the model. Longer diffs are cut, with a warning.

hushcommit.temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent with each request.

hushcommit.maxTokens.description: max_tokens sent with each request. 0 means don't send it. Some servers require it.

hushcommit.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the server before giving up.

hushcommit.allowRemote.description: Allow a baseUrl whose host is not localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1. When off, the staged diff never leaves this machine.
